chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"It is not appropriate for anyone to take soil from around the House, and if he takes anything from that, he should return it."

key_terms.تُرْبَةِ: soil or earth taken from the ground

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to take soil from around the Kaʿbah during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states that one should not take soil from the area surrounding the Kaʿbah. If any of it is taken, it must be returned, indicating the sanctity and protected status of the sacred precinct connected to hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2335 - It has been narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdullah (as):
"It is not appropriate for anyone to take soil from around the House (Kaaba), and if someone takes anything from it, they must return it."
